prompt: Compare two views of the same aerial crop. Left is the original. Right is identical with cyan lines from an existing prediction. A cable may be dark or bright, thin, curved, or parallel to another cable. Cyan alone is not evidence of a real cable. Look for actual overhead wires visible on the LEFT which have missing cyan segments on the RIGHT. Return one JSON object only: region (copy {region}), visibility (none, uncertain, clear), missing (none, short, long), reason (up to 15 words). If the crop is empty or no wire is visible, choose none for both. Use long for a clearly missing cable or substantial segment. Ground markings, roof edges, and branches are background.
